contributions.statement: Pre-select a token-budgeted, directory-preserving slice of the file tree (name match to task tokens, depth and extension priors) for the agent's first turn.
contributions.evidence: §3.2 Table 1: sigma-Reveal gains are small and inconsistent, single Qwen3-14B run, 6-step shell tasks with a 10 s sandbox, largest gains on the authors' own ShellOps dataset.
relative_to: repository map / file-tree preview in the initial context (e.g. Aider repo map)

reason: The main contribution is an RL credit-assignment method for a self-trained 14B policy, which the team will not train. The one harness-side idea is a known repo-map heuristic with weak, noisy evidence.
